caption: A papadum is dropped into hot oil, and it puffs up and doubles in size within seconds.

sa.check: A flat papadum is dropped into hot oil.
The papadum keeps its puffed shape when lifted out.
The drop comes first and the puffing follows.

pc.expect: The flat disc raises blisters and swells into a thicker bubbled round, staying one piece that keeps its outline.
pc.fail: The papadum stays perfectly flat and smooth while plainly larger; or it swells into a smooth ball with no blisters; or it splits into separate pieces as it puffs; or it turns into another shape such as a tube.

pc.expect: The swelling only advances in the oil and the papadum does not shrink back once puffed.
pc.fail: The papadum shrinks back flat in the oil; or it puffs and flattens in turn; or it is puffed before it reaches the oil; or it collapses as it is lifted out and stays flat.

pc.expect: The papadum rides at the oil's surface or is held under it, the bubbles rise, and any oil runs off it when lifted.
pc.fail: The papadum sinks to the pot's floor and stays; or hangs motionless in mid-oil; or bubbles sink toward the pot's floor; or oil climbs the papadum as it is lifted out.

pc.expect: The oil shows the papadum arriving: it bubbles hard around it and the papadum goes glossy.
pc.fail: The papadum enters and the oil stays glassy still; or the oil bubbles before the papadum reaches it; or the papadum puffs while the oil around it stays flat and clear; or the papadum stays dry and matt in the oil.

pc.expect: One papadum in one pot; it stays one piece and the oil stays in the pot.
pc.fail: A second papadum appears; or the papadum vanishes; or oil passes through the pot's wall; or the papadum passes through the pot's floor.

pc.expect: The pot, the oil's colour and the surroundings stay the same.
pc.fail: The pot changes colour; or the oil changes colour; or items around the pot rearrange.

note: The papadum browning as it fries is chemistry and is not judged.
